correctness.rationale: Checked the complete 28-page primary AIMS PDF directly, especially printed uncontrolled Eq(1) on page5 and controlled Eq(16) on page15: source incidence lambda*S*I/(1+c*A) becomes lambda*S*I/(1+A), so setting all ui=1 fails to reproduce Eq(1) when c!=1 and ASI>0. Summing all six human compartments in Eq(16) cancels every proper internal transfer except (1-u1)*A*(r1I+r2Q+r3H), yielding Ndot=Pi-dN-delta*(I+Q+H)+(1-u1)*flux. Independent Fraction arithmetic verifies original 1/44 vs 1/48 incidence and defect 7/400. Repairing recovered gain by u1 changes Hamiltonian derivative to B1 u1+(xi6-xi3)r1AI+(xi6-xi4)r2AQ+(xi6-xi5)r3AH, hence stated projected optimality law under paper’s quadratic 1/2 B1 u1². The correction is to the repaired MODEL, not to the printed original Hamiltonian.
